title: oenothera contorta var. divaricata
intro: Oenothera contorta var. divaricata, commonly known as the 'Hooked Evening Primrose', is a plant species within the evening primrose family. This plant is traditionally used to support the health and well-being of individuals, offering benefits such as wound healing and the soothing of skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera contorta var. divaricata include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include fatty acids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contributing to its medicinal properties.
